name: toy-sharing
description: ToyShare - nền tảng chia sẻ đồ chơi (MERN). Scripts chạy cả backend + frontend bằng 1 lệnh.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix toy-sharing-backend install && npm --prefix toy-sharing-frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm --prefix toy-sharing-backend run dev" "npm --prefix toy-sharing-frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BE,FE -c blue,green "npm --prefix toy-sharing-backend start" "npm --prefix toy-sharing-frontend run dev"
